name: io.github.iowarp/slurm-mcp
title: CLIO Slurm
description: MCP server for Slurm workload management and HPC job scheduling

tools.name: slurm_submit
tools.description: Submit one Slurm job or array and return its scheduler-native job ID. Set array only for an array submission.

tools.name: slurm_list
tools.description: List a bounded number of Slurm jobs with optional user, state, and partition filters. Returns native IDs and explicit truncation state.

tools.name: slurm_describe
tools.description: Describe one scheduler-native Slurm job: lifecycle state, terminality, scheduler properties, and optional bounded stdout/stderr tails.

tools.name: slurm_cluster
tools.description: Inspect bounded Slurm partition and queue records in one snapshot. Node details are excluded by default and bounded when requested.

tools.name: slurm_cancel
tools.description: Request destructive cancellation of one Slurm job. confirm_job_id must exactly repeat job_id; omission or mismatch is rejected without calling scancel.

prompts.name: submit_job_workflow
prompts.description: Guided workflow for submitting and monitoring a Slurm job.
